signals.text: 5 open PM roles across 2 US offices

news.title: Faire's Second State of Independent Retail Report Finds Independent Shelves Stay Distinct, Even as the Category Grows

roles.title: Director of Product, Discovery Algorithms
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA

bullets: Coach and develop PMs across your group. Manage the senior PMs who lead our algorithm-driven teams. Set expectations, coach on the work, and give feedback that helps them grow.
Uplevel our algorithmic thinking and strategy. Bring a sharp point of view on where gains in search, ranking, and personalization will come from. Review your PMs’ strategies and…
Understand retailers and brands. Use qualitative and quantitative research to find the problems that matter most, and decide which are worth solving.
Represent Discovery to senior leadership. Explain the group’s strategy, results, and bets, and shape the direction for how retailers find and buy on Faire.
Raise the bar on how product, data science, engineering, and data work together, including as AI changes how that partnership operates.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Retailer & App Experience

bullets: Own the vision and strategy for the Faire app, grounded in what retailers want and say about it.
Review app work across teams to ensure a cohesive experience that meets our app goals, and monitor the app’s metrics.
Own the vision for our core buying-journey components, including product tile, brand tile, product grid, filters, and global navigation, and set how they work across surfaces.
Define the metrics that quantify the impact of experience improvements, and build a shared view of impact across contributing teams.
Partner with design, engineering, and PM leaders across Discovery and other pillars to make shared components scale across surfaces.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Brand Success
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA

bullets: Set the strategy for brand success. Deeply understand which behaviors make brands successful on Faire, what blocks brands from adopting them, and where guidance should come from…
Own the brand success roadmap end-to-end. Define strategy and sequencing across rebuilding key systems, shipping contextual nudges, and deep-diving into top actions.
Go deep on the highest-value actions. Understand blockers, build education and reasons to believe, determine contextual moments to target, and make each action as close to one…
Build the targeting and triggering system. Estimate the LTV impact of each action, rank each brand’s personalized top opportunities, and fire on the behavioral moments when a…
Own the growth hub and rationalize our nudge systems. Give brands a single place to see what is limiting their growth and their top actions, and consolidate today’s banners…

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Incentives
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA

bullets: Own strategy and roadmap for Faire’s incentives. Set the long term direction for how seasonal sales, spend challenges, Insider, and future benefits evolve, and build the…
Bring Faire’s benefits together into one experience. Orchestrate today’s programs so retailers and brands experience them as a single, seamless system, and determine the next…
Own the return on every incentive dollar. Think in unit economics, cost per outcome, and payback periods. Invest where incentives drive the most value, and manage the P&L…
Build the targeting platform. Develop the targeting capabilities that put the right incentive in front of the right customer at the right time, and design simple, delightful…
Partner deeply across Finance, Legal, Data Science, Design, and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving…

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Search Ranking
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA

bullets: Develop and execute a strategy that takes our search experience to the next level via ranking algorithmic iterations.
Own a product roadmap for Search Ranking that is analytically grounded, clearly prioritized, and connected to business outcomes
Direct the analytical work of the pod — working alongside a dedicated strategy & analytics partner to identify novel opportunities, diagnose root causes of failure modes…
Determine the right sequencing of opportunities, including when to invest in technical/foundational work that unlocks future gains versus near-term order volume delivery
Define and refine the metrics that give the team a clear picture of Search Ranking performance and the retailer experience
